churches.name: Christ Church Moscow (Doug Wilson)
churches.address: Christ Church Hall, 820 Dominion Way, Moscow, ID 83843
churches.pastor_credentials: Christ Church Moscow founding pastor; founder of CREC (Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches); founder of Logos School + New Saint Andrews College; co-author Federal Vision theology
churches.services: Sundays — verify times on website (multiple campuses including Logos Fieldhouse 110 Baker St)
churches.overall_label: CREC mother church — confessionally Reformed but contested on Federal Vision + cultural posture

score_notes.christology: Reformed orthodox; Westminster + Three Forms compatible Christology.
score_notes.scripture: High view of Scripture; postmillennial covenantal hermeneutic.
score_notes.gender: Strongly complementarian / explicitly patriarchal household vision; male-only ordination; Wilson's Reforming Marriage / Federal Husband articulate the vision.
score_notes.leadership: CREC founder + multi-decade senior pastor — succession concerns flagged by outside observers; Christ Church plurality of elders, but Wilson is denominational center of gravity.
score_notes.soteriology: Federal Vision (FV) theology — contested by confessional Reformed (Westminster Seminary California, OPC, PCA report 2007) as conflating justification/sanctification, paedo-communion, objective covenant theology. Not clearly heretical but contested within Reformed orthodoxy. Yellow rating reflects this contested status.
score_notes.cultural: Christian nationalism advocacy; 'Make Moscow a Christian town' rhetoric; February 2026 prayed at Pentagon Christian worship service alongside Pete Hegseth (per ReligionNews/CNN coverage). Historical kinism-adjacent material disputed. Yellow reflects significant cultural-posture concerns; not red/black because doctrinal essentials remain orthodox.
score_notes.mission: Founded CREC (~150 congregations), Logos School (classical Christian schooling movement progenitor), New Saint Andrews College — significant church-planting + cultural-formation footprint.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Strong men's discipleship via patriarchy-explicit teaching; Wilson's Reforming Marriage / Federal Husband / Fidelity material foundational.
score_notes.denominational: CREC is small (~150 congregations) and Wilson-centered; Federal Vision is rejected by NAPARC denominations; insular reputation.

churches.assessment: Christ Church Moscow, founded 1976 by Douglas Wilson, is the mother congregation of the CREC and a major node in the classical-Christian-education and Christian-nationalist networks. Theology is broadly Reformed but holds Federal Vision positions formally rejected by confessional NAPARC denominations (PCA, OPC, URCNA). Cultural posture has drawn national attention (CNN, Religion News Service, MinistryWatch) for Christian-nationalist rhetoric and February 2026 Pentagon prayer service alongside Pete Hegseth. Doctrinal essentials remain orthodox; the yellow rating reflects contested-Federal-Vision soteriology + cultural-posture concerns, not heresy. Listed as a major reference congregation rather than recommendation.
churches.gender_detail: Patriarchal-complementarian; male-only ordination; Wilson's published material (Reforming Marriage, Federal Husband) articulates the position.
churches.denomination_detail: CREC (Communion of Reformed Evangelical Churches) — founded 1998 by Wilson + 2 affiliated WA congregations; ~150 churches denomination-wide; rejected by NAPARC for Federal Vision theology.
churches.enrichment_notes:
Verified via WebSearch 2026-04-30: 820 Dominion Way Moscow ID 83843 main location + Logos Fieldhouse 110 Baker St. Federal Vision contested; Christian nationalism heavily covered in 2025-2026 secular press. Yellow rating reflects FV soteriology + cultural posture without claiming heresy.
